finding: headless Chromium at iPhone 13 size: no errors, no horizontal scroll, persistence survives reload. But three consecutive Try taps left the mood label at 'curious' and Hold changed nothing on screen. Every act was feedback-dead, which violates the brief's one non-negotiable rule.
re_derivation: not a tuning problem, so mood numbers were not raised. The reducer already wrote a reaction for every act; the UI buried it below the fold and let the next proposal overwrite the bubble. Fix = show what already exists: lastReaction(S) derives the reaction from the event log (still the only source, no new state field), the bubble shows reaction then proposal, Lulu's face is drawn from moodLabel (6 expressions), a bounce on every act, and the Try reaction names what was gained.
defect_caught: worried face initially smiled (mouth corners above the line); caught by screenshot, fixed

verification.browser: iPhone 13 viewport; every one of the 6 verbs shows a reaction; 0 page errors
